nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every Friday at 5:00 PM local time

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURABLE VARIABLES:
- githubRepo: Repository in 'owner/repo' format
- destinationChannel: Slack channel or delivery target name
- language: Summary language (EN = English, FR = French)

nodes.name: Compute Date Range
nodes.notes: Computes ISO date strings (since, until) for the last 7 days

nodes.name: GitHub - Get Commits
nodes.notes: Fetches commits from last 7 days. Requires GitHub API credential.

nodes.name: GitHub - Get Issues
nodes.notes: Fetches closed issues from last 7 days. PRs are filtered out in a later step.

nodes.name: GitHub - Get PRs
nodes.notes: Fetches closed PRs. Only merged PRs (merged_at not null, within date range) are kept later.

nodes.name: Clean Commits
nodes.notes: Collapses commit list into a single item with context preserved

nodes.name: Clean Issues
nodes.notes: Collapses issues list into a single item, filtering out PRs

nodes.name: Clean PRs
nodes.notes: Collapses PRs list into a single item, keeping only merged PRs within date range

nodes.name: Merge Data
nodes.notes: Combines the cleaned commits, issues, and PRs into one item with keys 0, 1, 2

nodes.name: Build Summary & Prompt
nodes.notes: Extracts data from Merge node output, builds summary stats, and constructs the Claude prompt with language support (EN/FR)

nodes.name: Claude API - Generate Summary
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Sonnet 4 with the built prompt. Requires Anthropic API credential (x-api-key). The 'messages' field uses an expression to build a proper JSON array.

nodes.name: Format Output
nodes.notes: Formats Claude's response into the final message. Falls back to a stats-only summary if Claude API fails.

nodes.name: Final Output
nodes.notes: Workflow complete. The output message is in the 'message' field. Connect this to a Slack/Teams/Email/Webhook node to deliver, or view in execution history.
